messages:
maria: Quick async update for APAC-2 onboarding (ap-southeast-2). TL;DR: infra mostly provisioned, routing policy drafted, data-residency legal signoff still pending. Owners: leo (infra), sam (network/routing), anya (sre), karen (compliance). Target cutover: Thu 2026-03-19. Please call out any blockers by EOD PST.

leo: Infra status: 3 gpu pools created (gaia-cluster-apac2), autoscaler hooks in place. VPC peering to prod-controlplane done. Blocking: subnet NACL-003 denies outbound to 10.40.0.0/16 for now — need security rule update.

sam: Drafted routing policy and failover. Sharing snippet, feedback welcome. Need final allowed CIDR list from security before I push.
```yaml
routing_policy:
  region: ap-southeast-2
  preferred: ap-southeast-2-primary
  fallback: - ap-east-1
  match: 
    - header: "x-redwood-region"
      exact: "ap-southeast-2"
  acl: ALLOW_FROM_SECURITY_LIST # placeholder
```

anya: SRE checklist: healthchecks wired, canary queue created. Planning 1h smoke window after cutover. Will run perf bench @50rps for 30m. Can someone add the canary job to the oncall rota?

karen: Compliance: reviewing data residency docs. Need confirmation on persistent logs retention — is retention 90 days for APAC workloads? If so I can signoff pending encryption key location (KMS region).

maria: Confirm retention: 90 days for now. KMS will be customer-managed in ap-southeast-2 for Private customers; for Hosted we'll use central KMS in us-west-2 with key policy restricting access to APAC region services. Karen, is that sufficient?

karen: For Hosted, we need a documented exception and an entry in the audit plan. If maria can link the exception request I'll queue it for review.

leo: Re: NACL-003 — @security-team (cc karen) we need outbound rule to 10.40.0.0/16 for control-plane callbacks. Patch is in PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-3897 (small change). Would someone from security do a quick review?

sam: Routing PR: https://git.redwood/networking/PR-2214 — includes the YAML above and integration tests. Needs an approver from eng-platform. @maria can you review?

maria: I'll review both PRs by EOD. Quick note: add a rollback playbook to the routing PR — steps to revert traffic back to ap-east-1 and metrics to watch (error-rate, p95 latency, token-drop rate).

anya: Oncall rota: I'll add the canary job and notify oncall 2 hours before cutover. deploy-bot will post alerts.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] Canary job for apac-onboard set for 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z — will post start/finish.

devops-bot: Nightly infra bootstrap completed for gaia-cluster-apac2 at 2026-03-10T05:12:00Z.

sam: One more ask — CDN edge mapping needs the new origin mapping for apac2. @edge-team, can we get TTL set to 60s for first 48h?

maria: Good call. If edge-team OKs TTL 60s we can detect routing regressions faster. Adding to cutover checklist.

karen: I'll prepare the audit entry and KMS exception request today. Expect signoff tomorrow morning.

leo: After PR reviews, I plan to run a dry traffic shift in staging Thursday morning. Will post results.

maria: Thanks all — action items summarized: (1) karen: audit + KMS exception, (2) security: review PR-3897 NACL change, (3) maria: review PRs and add rollback playbook, (4) sam: update CDN TTL with edge-team, (5) anya: schedule canary and add to rota. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

sam: quick question — who owns post-cutover monitoring dashboard? i'll add a dashboard link placeholder to PR.

anya: I can own first 24h monitoring and hand off to platform-observability after.

maria: Perfect. I'll add owners section to the main runbook.

leo: LGTM.

karen: 👍 will update once audit entry created.
